Hi Maya / Halo Legal team,

Thanks for taking the time on the redlines this week. Before we create the final DocuSign envelope, two quick operational items we need from you so we route correctly and avoid any rework:

2) Signing mode: do you prefer parallel signing (all signers get the envelope at once) or sequential (sign-by-order)? We recommend sequential for multi-entity signings to reduce parallel conflicts, but we'll follow Halo's preference.

I've attached our last redline pass (MSA + OF v3) and a sample signer-authority template — if you can return the completed authority forms, we will:
- Bake the signer names into the envelope
- Configure the routing lanes (primary signer / witness / countersign)

Proposed internal routing: Ben will be the deal owner for signature ops, Laura will QA the final PDFs, and Jonas will be on standby in case we need an expedited clean-copy export for procurement archives.

Timeline: if we receive the confirmed signer list and authority forms by EOD Monday (Nov 8), we can send the DocuSign envelope on Nov 9 and aim to have fully executed PDFs back by Nov 10–11.

Thanks — point person here is me (soojin.lee@redwood.com).

Best,
